title: Luxe 1BR Steps to Broadway | Heated Pool
description:
Stay in the heart of Downtown Nashville just steps from Broadway and Bridgestone Arena. This stylish 1BR retreat sleeps up to 6 guests and features a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TV, fast WiFi, and a unique speakeasy-inspired design. Enjoy premium amenities including a heated pool, rooftop sky deck, fitness center, fire pits, and outdoor lounges. Perfect for couples, friends, concertgoers, and Music City getaways.

The space
Luxury Downtown Nashville Retreat

Welcome to your stylish Nashville hideaway, blending modern comfort with a sophisticated speakeasy-inspired atmosphere. Located in the heart of downtown, this thoughtfully designed space places you steps from Broadway, entertainment, dining, and Nashville's most iconic attractions.

Sleeping Arrangements

🛏️ Bedroom

Queen bed

🛏️ Additional Sleeping Options

Twin daybed with pull-out trundle (converts to queen)
Memory foam rollaway bed

👥 Accommodates up to 6 guests

Apartment Features

🛋️ Open-concept living area with oversized plush sofa

📺 Smart TV for streaming and entertainment

🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with cooking essentials and Keurig coffee maker

🍽️ Bar-height dining area perfect for meals and gatherings

🛁 Full bathroom with soaking tub

💄 Vanity area with LED mirror and USB charging ports

🧳 Spacious closet with extra linens and towels

🛍️ Personal shopping niche with curated items available for purchase

Resort-Style Amenities

🏊 Heated pool

🔥 Outdoor fire pits and lounge areas

🍔 BBQ grilling stations

🌆 Rooftop sky deck

💪 Two-story fitness center

🧘 Yoga space

🧗 Climbing wall

Nearby Attractions

🎶 Broadway – 2-minute walk

🏟️ Bridgestone Arena – 2-minute walk

🎤 Ryman Auditorium – 5-minute walk

🏆 Country Music Hall of Fame – 6-minute walk

🛍️ Fifth + Broadway – 3-minute walk

🍽️ Assembly Food Hall – 3-minute walk

Permit #2018070674

Guest access
Guests will have full private access to the apartment and shared access to all community amenities at The Burnham.

The building utilizes the LATCH access system for secure entry. Prior to arrival, access instructions will be provided to allow entry to the building, apartment, elevators, amenities, and common areas.

Guests may access:

Entire private apartment
Heated pool
Rooftop sky deck
Fitness center
Yoga studio
Outdoor lounges and fire pits
Shared building common areas
Bathroom: Entrances from both your bedroom and the living area.

🚗 One priority parking space may be reserved upon request for $35/night.

Other things to note
Other Things to Note

Please note that building amenities are managed by the property and may occasionally be unavailable due to maintenance or unforeseen circumstances. Refunds cannot be provided for temporary amenity closures.

Important Property Rules:

🔇 Quiet Hours: 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM

🏊 Pool Hours: 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

🌳 Courtyard Hours: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

👥 All guests must be listed on the reservation

🚭 No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property

🎉 No parties or unauthorized gatherings

🍹 No glass allowed on balconies, pool deck, or courtyard areas

🗑️ Trash must be disposed of properly and not left in hallways

🎭 Downtown Nashville is an active entertainment district, and city noise may occasionally be experienced

🏢 Building amenities and common spaces are shared with other residents and guests
